Methane Over America

Try the way I think

These are the three things I check first in any sustainability claim: a real number, a baseline, and a defined scope. Pick a sample or paste your own sentence.

This is a simplified rule-based illustration of three checks. The real ScopeCheck uses the Claude API to extract claims from full reports and score each one against 7 criteria (baseline year, scope, absolute vs intensity, third-party verification, time-bound target, offset disclosure, methodology), citing the exact sentence behind every flag.

Fast fashion and unclear climate claims share the same failure: nobody checks the receipts.

I spend my days building the receipts. Closet First Stylist uses computer vision so people reach for clothes they already own instead of buying new. ScopeCheck uses an AI agent to catch sustainability claims that don't cite a real number. Mangrove Monitor and the methane tracker turn satellite data into something a policy analyst can actually read. Different fields, same habit: follow the data until the story holds up, or admit that it doesn't.
